name: Amanogawa Biura
source:
Birthday: July 7 (Her real date of birth is unknown, this is the day when she was picked up).
Hobbies: Housework
Favorite food: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Takuan]Takuan[/url]
[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D%C5%8Dbutsu_uranai]Zoological fortune-telling[/url]: Fawn.

Eldest daughter. 1st year student at Akahoshi Academy (Currently temporarily suspended).
